title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Following a ceasefire after military attacks halted QatarEnergy's LNG production at Ras Laffan and Mesaieed facilities on March 3, 2026, the state-owned firm mobilized engineers by April 8 to restart operations, with reports confirming two trains back online by mid-April amid easing tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. This swift progress, including partial resumption without further disruptions, drives trader consensus implying 99.8% probability of an announcement or restart by April 30, reflecting the wisdom of crowds on reliable supply restoration. Realistic upset scenarios remain slim but include renewed regional conflict, unforeseen repair delays, or extended force majeure declarations blocking full-scale output.

title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Winner
description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: France holds a slim trader consensus edge at 16.8% implied probability to win the 2026 FIFA World Cup, bolstered by Kylian Mbappé entering peak age and Didier Deschamps' pedigree from back-to-back finals appearances, following strong March qualifier results including a 1-0 win over Bosnia. Spain trails closely at 15.3%, buoyed by Euro 2024 success, Lamine Yamal's emergence despite minor injury concerns, and a favorable Group E with Turkey. The bunched top tier—England (11.1%), Argentina and Brazil (8.6%)—reflects the expanded 48-team field's volatility post-qualification play-offs on March 31, where European powerhouses dominated amid balanced group draws and no dominant runaway form, keeping the race competitive with multiple paths through group stage and knockouts.

title: Counter-Strike: Natus Vincere vs Vitality (BO5) - BLAST Rivals Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Grand final match between Natus Vincere and Vitality in the BLAST Rivals Playoffs, initially scheduled for May 3 at 1:30PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Natus Vincere" if Natus Vincere win the match against Vitality.

This market will resolve to "Vitality" if Vitality win the match against Natus Vincere.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: World #1 Vitality, boasting a superstar roster of apEX, ZywOo, flameZ, mezii, and ropz, faces #2 Natus Vincere (Aleksib, iM, b1t, w0nderful, makazze) in the BLAST Rivals Spring 2026 grand final BO5 at Dickies Arena. Vitality advanced with a dominant 2-0 semifinal win over GamerLegion, crushing Mirage 13-11 before an overtime 16-14 Overpass victory highlighted by flameZ's clutches. NaVi secured their spot via 2-0 sweeps of FaZe in semis and quarters, riding a three-match streak on maps like Dust2 and Anubis. Vitality holds a lopsided head-to-head edge (18-1), including a recent 3-0 grand final win, amid stable CS2 meta and no roster changes, positioning this LAN decider for $350,000 as tightly contested despite Vitality's momentum.

eventMetadata.context_description: With the Eastern Conference first-round series tied 3-3, Detroit Pistons host Orlando Magic in a decisive Game 7 at Little Caesars Arena, leveraging home-court advantage as the top seed. Orlando's offense has faltered without Franz Wagner, ruled out for a third straight game with a right calf strain after his Game 4 injury helped spark Detroit's comeback wins in Games 5 (116-109) and 6 (93-79 rally from 24 down). Jonathan Isaac remains sidelined (left knee), thinning the frontcourt, while Pistons guard Kevin Huerter is questionable (adductor) and Jalen Duren nurses a hand injury from Game 6. Momentum favors Detroit's recent form against a shorthanded Magic squad facing elimination.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket positions Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as the narrow frontrunner for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination at 49%, propelled by his high-profile role as HHS Secretary advancing Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) initiatives that resonate with the GOP base skeptical of federal health agencies and big pharma, bolstered by recent confirmation and national "Take Back Your Health" events. Vice President J.D. Vance holds strong at 39% as the MAGA heir apparent with incumbency advantages, though his odds reflect competition amid early polls showing leads eroding slightly. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 21.4% share stems from recent foreign policy successes like Venezuela operations, a 35% CPAC straw poll finish, and GOP donor efforts to draft him as an establishment alternative, underscoring a closely contested post-Trump primary field ahead of 2027 caucuses.

title: LoL: Ninjas in Pyjamas vs Bilibili Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Ninjas in Pyjamas and Bilibili Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 3 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Ninjas in Pyjamas" if Ninjas in Pyjamas win the match against Bilibili Gaming.

This market will resolve to "Bilibili Gaming" if Bilibili Gaming win the match against Ninjas in Pyjamas.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Any Player Quadra Kill?
markets.description:
This market is about whether any player achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. In League of Legends, a Quadra Kill occurs when a single player kills 4 enemy champions in rapid succession.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player on either team achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if no player achieves a Quadra Kill. A Penta Kill (5 kills in rapid succession) also counts as a Quadra Kill having occurred for the purposes of this market.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether a Quadra Kill occurred prior to stoppage. If no Quadra Kill occurred, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

This market is about whether any player achieves a Penta Kill during Game 2. In League of Legends, a Penta Kill occurs when a single player kills all 5 enemy champions in rapid succession.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player on either team achieves a Penta Kill during Game 2. This market will resolve to "No" if no player achieves a Penta Kill.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 2 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether a Penta Kill occurred prior to stoppage. If no Penta Kill occurred, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 2 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Bilibili Gaming leads LPL Split 2 Group Ascend at 7-2 series record with a +8 game differential, driven by midlaner Knight's MVP-caliber play and ADC Viper's carry threat in recent wins over TES and AL, positioning them for direct playoffs qualification in the double round-robin format. Ninjas in Pyjamas languishes 5th at 4-4 following a two-series skid, despite their 2-0 upset over BLG last week via Guwon's jungle pressure and Assum's botlane output. This rematch BO3 under patch 26.7's teamfight meta and fearless draft tests NIP's Shenzhen home edge against BLG's superior macro and head-to-head resilience, with stakes high for NIP's play-in avoidance.

title: Indian Premier League: Gujarat Titans vs Punjab Kings
description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Gujarat Titans and Punjab Kings scheduled for May 3 2026 in Indian Premier League.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. If the match ends tied and no on-field tiebreak is used or available under the playing conditions (e.g., group-stage ODI with no Super Over), the market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed/rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed. If the match is permanently canceled or abandoned or otherwise is completed without a winner, the market resolves 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

markets.question: Indian Premier League: Gujarat Titans vs Punjab Kings - Completed match?
markets.description:
This market refers to whether the cricket match between Gujarat Titans and Punjab Kings scheduled for 2026-05-03 in Indian Premier League is completed under the competition's official playing conditions.
This market resolves according to the finalized match status as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
Any match where an official result is declared — including results decided by DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, a Super Over, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling — will resolve Yes. (Draws count as completed results when recognized by the competition.)
If the match is abandoned, ends in No Result, is permanently canceled, or otherwise concludes without an official result, the market will resolve No.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed or permanently canceled, after which it will resolve as described above.

markets.question: Indian Premier League: Gujarat Titans vs Punjab Kings
markets.description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Gujarat Titans and Punjab Kings scheduled for May 3 2026 in Indian Premier League.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. If the match ends tied and no on-field tiebreak is used or available under the playing conditions (e.g., group-stage ODI with no Super Over), the market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed/rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed. If the match is permanently canceled or abandoned or otherwise is completed without a winner, the market resolves 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gujarat Titans host Punjab Kings in IPL 2026 Match 46 at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad, where a batting-friendly pitch averages 179 in first innings and favors chases half the time. PBKS top the points table after nine games but seek recovery from their first loss, hampered by Shashank Singh's hamstring absence and bowling vulnerabilities despite deep batting led by Shreyas Iyer and Marcus Stoinis. Resurgent GT, captained by Shubman Gill with Sai Sudharsan back from rib injury, boast a well-rounded attack featuring Rashid Khan, Kagiso Rabada, and Mohammed Siraj, plus home advantage and recent momentum. GT won the toss and opted to bowl, introducing debutant Nishant Sindhu while Xavier Bartlett replaces Lockie Ferguson for PBKS in a head-to-head level at 3-3 historically.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: Raptors vs. Cavaliers
description:
In the upcoming NBA game, scheduled for May 3 at 12:00AM ET:
If the Raptors win, the market will resolve to "Raptors".
If the Cavaliers win, the market will resolve to "Cavaliers".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Cleveland Cavaliers hold home-court advantage hosting the Toronto Raptors in Game 7 of their first-round NBA playoff series, tied 3-3 at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse, where trader consensus reflects the Cavs' health edge and crowd support. Toronto's dramatic Game 6 comeback victory—sealed by RJ Barrett's go-ahead 3-pointer after trailing early—forced the decider, with Scottie Barnes dominating on both ends despite the Raptors' ongoing injury woes. Key absences include Immanuel Quickley (out, right hamstring strain) and Brandon Ingram (doubtful, right heel inflammation), thinning Toronto's backcourt and scoring punch, while Cleveland enters fully healthy featuring Donovan Mitchell's playoff scoring and Jarrett Allen's rim protection. Recent close games underscore the series' volatility, with rest negligible in this elimination matchup.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gavin Newsom leads trader consensus at 27% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, buoyed by his commanding 28% in a March California primary poll—his home-state stronghold—and national visibility through book tours in early primary states like New Hampshire. Kamala Harris trails at 10% despite her April 10 statement at the National Action Network affirming she's "thinking about" another run, weighed down by her 2024 general election loss, while Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's 8% reflects strong youth poll support amid progressive buzz. In this wide-open field lacking an incumbent, key differentiators include Newsom's executive record and fundraising prowess, Harris's vice-presidential name recognition, and AOC's appeal to young voters; consolidation could hinge on 2026 midterm outcomes, early caucus polling, and party endorsements.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:
This market will resolve to the country whose candidate for Eurovision 2026 wins.

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If no winner is announced by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve "Other". All ties will be broken according to EBU's official Eurovision rules.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen command 33.9% implied probability as frontrunners with "Liekinheitin," their violin-driven pop anthem winning UMK and dominating bookmakers since all 35 songs dropped in March, buoyed by strong pre-party reactions and unique crossover appeal. Greece's Akylas trails at 18.4% on vibrant "Ferto," enhanced by a "Super Ferto" remix last week that amplifies televote potential amid dance-pop momentum from Sing for Greece. Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund sits at 12.6% with emotional ballad "Før Vi Går Hjem," leveraging Melodi Grand Prix victory and Nordic jury favoritism. Australia (Delta Goodrem's star power) and France (Monroe's chic entry) differentiate via artist draw, but pre-rehearsal uncertainty keeps the Vienna field wide-open for shifts in live staging and voter sentiment.

title: LoL: ThunderTalk Gaming vs LNG Esports (BO3) - LPL Group Nirvana
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between ThunderTalk Gaming and LNG Esports in the LPL Group Nirvana, initially scheduled for May 3 at 5:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "ThunderTalk Gaming" if ThunderTalk Gaming win the match against LNG Esports.

This market will resolve to "LNG Esports" if LNG Esports win the match against ThunderTalk Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 1. In League of Legends, elemental dragons (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Hextech, Chemtech, and Cloud) spawn in the dragon pit starting at 5:00 game time. After being slain, the next dragon spawns 5 minutes later. Once a team claims the Dragon Soul (by slaying four dragons), all subsequent dragon spawns become Elder Dragons.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both ThunderTalk Gaming and LNG Esports each slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay any elemental dragon during Game 1. Only elemental dragons count toward this market — Elder Dragon kills do not count.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain at least one elemental dragon prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: In LPL 2026 Split 2 Group Nirvana's single round robin, ThunderTalk Gaming (2-2) faces LNG Esports (2-1) in a pivotal BO3 series, with top four spots advancing to playoffs play-in and bottom two eliminated. TT dropped to fourth after a 1-2 loss to LGD Gaming last week, exposing macro inconsistencies despite strong mid-jungle synergy, while LNG strengthened their third-place hold with recent wins and superior +627 gold differential at 15 minutes versus top foes. TT holds recent head-to-head edge, sweeping LNG 2-0 on March 28, but LNG's sidelane pressure and early tempo could exploit under Hard Fearless Draft rules. Stable rosters amplify execution in the current meta.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim lead in trader consensus at 21.3% implied probability for the 2028 presidential winner, trailed closely by California Governor Gavin Newsom at 17.5% and Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 10.2%, underscoring a fragmented field over two years before Election Day amid President Trump's second term. A late-March UMass Lowell poll gave Vance a narrow 33%-30% edge over Newsom in a head-to-head matchup, while Vance's April donor outreach with top Republicans builds early momentum as the GOP heir apparent. Newsom maintains Democratic frontrunner status despite unfavorable ratings in a recent Harvard poll, and Rubio gains from high-profile diplomacy on Venezuela and Iran. The bunched odds reflect pre-primary volatility; 2026 midterms, Trump's endorsement signals, scandals, or policy outcomes could widen gaps.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices "No" at 97%, reflecting the Iranian regime's sustained control despite severe pressures from ongoing protests, economic collapse, and fallout from US-Israeli airstrikes and the February assassination of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. Recent developments, including an April execution spree and mass arrests targeting dissenters, alongside new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's late-April statements signaling Gulf stabilization efforts amid his recovery from injuries, underscore security forces' loyalty and suppression tactics. eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' superior constructor performance has propelled Kimi Antonelli to the top of the 2026 F1 driver standings with 75 points after podium finishes in Australia, a maiden victory in China, and a win in Japan, including his third consecutive pole position for the ongoing Miami Grand Prix. Teammate George Russell trails closely at 68 points with an Australian GP win and consistent podiums, reflecting the team's dominant race pace and pit stop efficiency early in the season. Lando Norris at 10.8% gains traction from his Miami Sprint victory, highlighting McLaren's competitiveness, while Max Verstappen's lower 5.9% stems from Red Bull's relative struggles in recent Grands Prix. Trader consensus implies Antonelli's recovery from poor starts and Mercedes' reliability as key factors in the title race, with 16 events remaining.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects recent French polls showing Rassemblement National president Jordan Bardella leading first-round voting intentions for the 2027 presidential election, buoyed by his party's strong municipal election performance in March 2026 despite missing major cities, while former Prime Minister Édouard Philippe of Horizons emerges as the center-right figure best positioned to challenge him in a potential runoff. The race remains tight due to a fragmented field across far-right, conservative, left-wing, and centrist blocs—exacerbated by the hung National Assembly's ongoing instability under Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu, who survived no-confidence votes on the 2026 budget—and widespread public desire for change after a decade of Macron's presidency. Separation could arise from left-wing primary results in October 2026, government collapse triggering snap legislative polls, economic shocks, or standout campaign performances ahead of the April-May 2027 vote.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing US-Iran negotiations for a permanent peace deal, mediated by Pakistan, remain stalled after President Trump rejected Tehran's latest proposal on May 1, 2026, deeming it insufficient on key demands like nuclear curbs and ballistic missile limits. This follows a fragile two-week ceasefire agreed April 8 amid the 2026 Iran war, with initial marathon talks in Islamabad ending April 12 without accord, as Iran refused firm commitments against nuclear weapons development. Core disputes center on sanctions relief, reopening the Strait of Hormuz, regional security guarantees, and reparations. Escalating rhetoric from both sides raises risks of renewed conflict, while a second round of diplomacy hangs in uncertainty ahead of potential escalation deadlines.

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $150 in May?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation during May 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours. 

Per CME contract specifications for WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, a contract’s last trading day is three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day).

The active month changes at the start of the second trading session prior to the nearest listed contract’s last trading session. At that point, the next listed contract becomes the active month (i.e., for the final three trading sessions of the nearest listed contract, the contract for the next month is the active month). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Active Month WTI Crude Oil futures "High" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore?search=WTI, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation during May 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "Low" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours. 

Per CME contract specifications for WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, a contract’s last trading day is three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day).

The active month changes at the start of the second trading session prior to the nearest listed contract’s last trading session. At that point, the next listed contract becomes the active month (i.e., for the final three trading sessions of the nearest listed contract, the contract for the next month is the active month). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily low price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil front-month futures hover around $102 per barrel, reflecting trader consensus on near-term supply tightness after a 6.2 million-barrel draw in U.S. commercial inventories for the week ended April 24—far exceeding expectations—and persistent backwardation in the futures curve. Geopolitical tensions, including U.S.-Iran frictions and Strait of Hormuz risks, propelled prices above $105 earlier this week before a pullback on fragile ceasefire hopes. OPEC+ production adjustments, with recent cuts from Saudi Arabia, Russia, and others totaling over 200,000 barrels per day, underpin the balance amid softening global refinery runs projected to decline by 1 million barrels per day in 2026. Key catalysts include weekly EIA reports and potential OPEC+ meetings through May.

title: LoL: Team Heretics vs Shifters (BO3) - LEC Regular Season
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Team Heretics and Shifters in the LEC Regular Season, initially scheduled for May 3 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Team Heretics" if Team Heretics win the match against Shifters.

This market will resolve to "Shifters" if Shifters win the match against Team Heretics.

eventMetadata.context_description: Team Heretics and Shifters, both mired at the bottom of the LEC 2026 Spring regular season standings with records of 1-7 and 0-7 respectively, enter this BO3 matchup mathematically eliminated from playoffs contention. Heretics' dismal form continued with a 0-2 rout by Fnatic yesterday, capping a seven-series losing streak and a 1-18 map differential since late March amid roster inconsistencies like low KDA outputs from Ice and Tracyn. Shifters, on a parallel seven-series skid, recently snapped momentum woes via an EWC qualifier upset over Vitality, leveraging strong drafts. Head-to-head tilts slightly toward Heretics (3-2 in last five since 2024), but trader consensus reflects a coinflip between underperformers in Fearless Draft format, with patch meta favoring adaptable comps.

title: Miami Grand Prix: Driver Winner
description:

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of May?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 31, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing US naval blockade of Iranian ports, combined with Iranian restrictions and attacks—including a fresh incident today where small craft struck a cargo ship near the Strait of Hormuz—has kept maritime traffic at just 10% of normal levels, with only nine transits recorded in the last 24 hours versus a pre-crisis average of 60 daily. This dual standoff, rooted in the February US-Israeli strikes sparking the crisis, persists despite Iran's recent 14-point peace proposal under US review and fragile ceasefires that repeatedly collapsed. Mine clearance could take six months, war-risk insurance premiums have surged 30-fold, and stalled diplomacy signal low odds of resuming full commercial flows by May 31, aligning with trader consensus at 80.5% for "No."

Pre-match, Juventus entered as heavy favorites at around 77% implied probability due to home form and head-to-head dominance (19 wins in 30 meetings), but Verona's resilient away display and clinical finishing defied expectations in this crucial late-season table clash.

title: Elon Musk # tweets May 5 - May 12, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from May 5 12:00 PM ET to May 12, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from May 5 12:00 PM ET to May 12, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket clusters around 160-199 posts for Elon Musk's X activity from May 5-12, implying a daily pace of 20-25 amid recent volatility, with no outcome exceeding 17% probability. This reflects resolved prior weeks like May 2-4 at 37 posts (12/day average) and April 30-May 2 at 50 (17/day), down from March's 40+ daily highs driven by intense political and xAI commentary. The tight race highlights uncertainty from Musk's erratic posting—spiking on viral controversies or Tesla/SpaceX announcements—versus quieter stretches. Key differentiators include potential news catalysts next week, as engagement metrics show his outsized cultural influence, with traders eyeing historical swings for breakout edges.
